order: row-major, row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge
cell_lookup: col = floor((lon - west) / dlon), row = floor((north - lat) / dlat); value represents the cell (centre at west + (col + 0.5) * dlon)

elev.source: 10 m mean of HiRISE DEM 1 m (work/dem_10m.tif), areoid elevation

slope.source: maximum of the four 5 m-spacing slopes per 10 m cell (gdaldem slope on the 5 m mean DEM, -s 59274.7)

validation.note: rover tilt at 1389 waypoints; signed = grid slope - tilt

note_en: 10 m grid approximation for the draw tool; walking thresholds are assumptions (scripts/config.json walk)
note_ko: 10m 격자 기준 근사. 경사 기준은 가정(scripts/config.json walk)
